$description: Candidate source-derived tokens. Pinned target: Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10; manually reviewed subset: color (sRGB), dimension (px/rem), number and fontFamily. Default :root snapshot, not an explicitly declared light-only mode. Evidence and proposal status are in css-mapping.json and evidence/notes.md.

ink.$description: Retains source variable --ink and every var(--ink) binding; foreground and action background are not renamed into one universal foreground role.

surface.$description: Retains source variable --surface, used for body background and action foreground.

small.$description: Existing variable, with proposed reuse for action block padding; source action padding is literal.

medium.$description: Proposed spacing reuse for grid gap, action inline padding, panel padding and compact layout padding; equal literals do not prove an existing shared token.

large.$description: Proposed name for default layout padding.

control.$description: Retains source variable and action border-radius reference; separate from equal focus offset.

maxWidth.$description: Proposed name for layout max-width; no root-font conversion.

compact.$description: Proposed name for max-width media condition. CSS custom properties cannot drive media conditions; consumers must emit the literal 40rem.

body.$description: Source ordered generic family stack; availability and actual selected font are unobserved.

heading1.$description: Proposed name for h1 size; no px conversion.
Preserves unitless multiplier; no dimension or percent conversion.

actionHover.$description: Preserves opacity scalar in a number token; usage constrains 0..1, not a DTCG opacity type. Hover is declared, not exercised.

outlineWidth.$description: Extracted outline width only, not a reconstructed border composite.

outlineOffset.$description: Separate semantic candidate from radius.control despite equal numeric value.

panel.$description: Extracted panel border width only; style and dynamic color remain raw evidence.
